shots.camText: The face lets go · 60 mm · a long-lens wide, low, locked off, over the wall
shots.line: The daughter stands in the gateway with the bowl in her hands and the farmer at the wall beside her, small, backs to us; the Anvil fills the frame beyond. From 0.4 s the whole face shears away in slabs, drops slowly, breaks; dust blooms at its foot and starts to roll toward us. Silent. At 2.0 s she hugs the bowl to her chest; at 2.4 s he scoops her up and starts to turn.
shots.note: The event fills the frame (a third of its width and more): the bell's release failed at 4%. Scale from the two small figures. The sound has not arrived.

shots.camText: The valley runs · 28 mm · HANDHELD, chest height, running backward in front of him
shots.line: He runs straight at us through the gateway, his daughter under one arm, the bowl hugged to her chest. Behind him the valley's people run from their houses, the ox runs loose, and far behind the wall of dust rolls over the fields under the dark mass. He does not look back.
shots.note: The only handheld shot in the film. The sound arrives two seconds in.
